dialogue.speaker: djcreeper
text: The candles are moving by themselves. Are they listening?

dialogue.speaker: spooky-kids
text: Of course. Midnight is their favorite song. Don't miss a beat!

dialogue.speaker: djcreeper
text: Those pumpkins... are staring at me.

dialogue.speaker: spooky-kids
text: Then dance for them, little green one. Until the last flame.
